author: SickProdigy
description: Configure and automatically post RSS and Atom feeds to Discord channels.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server RSS feed URLs, channel destinations, templates, and delivery settings. It does not persistently store user data or metadata.
install_msg: This cog makes outbound requests to administrator-configured RSS or Atom feeds and stores feed URLs, destinations, templates, and delivery settings in Red Config. Use `[p]rsspublisher add <name> <channel> <url>` to add a feed.
name: RSSPublisher
short: Publish RSS and Atom feed updates
